Sam: Quick async — what I did / blockers / today:
- Did: trimmed .NET quickstart deps, adjusted packaging to use wheel fallback, pushed draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
- Blocker: mac M1 wheel build times out on our buildx runner (flaky), CI red on arm64
- Today: try a retry on an m1 builder + open a short PR to skip binary wheel on mac for now

Priya: Thanks — saw the failing job. Logs show the code-sign step is hanging around 12m mark. Could be sandbox or runner resource pressure. :thinking_face:

Sam: Agree. Workaround idea: publish a source sdist for mac + add a short note in quickstart about longer install times on M1. If we do that, we can unblock docs deploy.

Luis: I'll repro locally on an M1 VM later this morning. Also FYI the sampleapp e2e in sampleflow failed with missing env var (REDWOOD_API_KEY) — pushed a tiny commit to set a CI secret toggle.

Ana: Docs tweaks from my side: updated the CLI examples to use `redwood client init` (old `rw init` is outdated) and fixed a few headings. Preview link attached once build finishes.

doc-bot: Preview build queued for PR #482. (status: queued -> running)

Sam: Small code snippet I'm trying to land to bypass the wheel step (in build script):
```bash
# in .github/workflows/build.yml
- name: Build wheel (skip on mac)
  if: runner.os != 'macOS'
  run: python -m build
- name: Build sdist fallback
  run: python -m build --sdist
```

Sam: Asks: @Luis can you review the packaging change in PR #482 once you repro? @Priya can you skim the quickstart wording (link above)? If no blockers I'll merge around 12:30pm PT. :clock12:

Priya: Can review in ~2h, will flag any copy edits inline.

Luis: I'll start the M1 run now and update the thread when I have results. If it reproduces, I'll open a follow-up PR with the runner config tweak.

Sam: Thanks all — ping here with any urgent blockers.
